samples.text_head: Unaudited Net Asset Value | Company Announcement | Investegate Fundraise Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive UK Short Positions Meetings UK Newswire New Login Register Unaudited Net Asset Value Maven Income & Growth VCT 4 PLC 10 April 2026 Maven Income and Growth VCT 4 PLC Unaudited Net Asset Value The Directors confirm: · Unaudited net asset value (NAV) 1 of 53.32p per Ordinary Share as at 31 March 2026, after the payment of a second interim dividend of 1.00p per Ordinary Share on 16 January 2026, compared to the audited NAV of 55.28p per Ordinary Share as at 31 December 2025; and · NAV total return 2 of 153.67p per Ordinary Share as at 31 March 2026, compared to 154.63p per Ordinary Shares as at 31 December 2025. Notes: 1 The NAV as at 31 March 2026 is unaudited and reflects the closing bid price of quoted securities as at that date. The NAV incorporates the Directors' valuation of unlisted investments as at 31 March 2026. 2 NAV total return is the sum of NAV per Ordinary Share and dividends paid per Ordinary Share since launch. Issued on behalf of the Board Maven Capital Partners UK LLP Secretary 10 April 2026
